title: 104th Fighter Wing performs first unrestricted vertical climb in F-35A Lightning II
description:
The 104th Fighter Wing performs their first unrestricted vertical climb with the F-35A Lightning II, at Barnes Air National Guard Base, Westfield, Mass., September 4, 2026.

Performing and training for unrestricted vertical climbs enables the wing to rapidly launch combat-ready fighters without relying on traditional runways, ensuring pilots can maintain air superiority in any potential scenario. 

(U.S. Air National Guard video by Jay Hewitt)
